name: AccessibilityAgent
description: Run AI-powered accessibility tests using a virtual screen reader
author: AT Agent

inputs.name: testConfig
inputs.label: Test Configuration File
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to the test configuration file (JSON or text format with url|goal per line)

inputs.name: agentPath
inputs.label: Agent Path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path to the AT Agent installation directory

inputs.name: provider
inputs.label: LLM Provider
inputs.helpMarkDown: Select the LLM provider to use for the AI agent

inputs.name: openaiApiKey
inputs.label: OpenAI API Key
inputs.helpMarkDown: OpenAI API key (required if provider is OpenAI). Use a secret variable like $(OPENAI_API_KEY)

inputs.name: geminiApiKey
inputs.label: Gemini API Key
inputs.helpMarkDown: Google Gemini API key (required if provider is Gemini). Use a secret variable like $(GEMINI_API_KEY)

inputs.name: dashboardUrl
inputs.label: Dashboard URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: URL of the AT Agent Dashboard for live tracking and results storage

inputs.name: dashboardApiKey
inputs.label: Dashboard API Key
inputs.helpMarkDown: API key for the AT Agent Dashboard. Use a secret variable like $(DASHBOARD_API_KEY)

inputs.name: headless
inputs.label: Headless Browser
inputs.helpMarkDown: Run the browser in headless mode (no visible window)

inputs.name: continueOnFailure
inputs.label: Continue on Failure
inputs.helpMarkDown: Continue running remaining tests if one test fails

outputVariables.name: dashboardUrl
outputVariables.description: URL to view results on the dashboard

outputVariables.name: resultsJson
outputVariables.description: JSON string containing full test results
